SELECT 
    HomeID, 
    Homename, 
    HomeManager, 
    ManagerEmail 
FROM 
    Avery.HomeDetails 
WHERE 
    (HomeTypeName != 'Non Op Company' 
    AND HomeTypeName != 'Test Home')
    OR HomeTypeName IS NULL
